description: This file is a C header file defining APIs for configuring UDP Echo settings within the TR-069 device IP diagnostics, specifically for the Device.IP.Diagnostics.UDPEchoConfig object. It includes function prototypes for setting enable flags, interface, and UDP port parameters, along with necessary include directives and documentation comments.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable flag for UDP Echo, enabling or disabling the service.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Interface
methods.description: Sets the network interface or path over which UDP Echo requests are listened for and received.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_UDPPort
methods.description: Sets the UDP port number the server listens on for echo requests.
